description: This file is a JavaScript module that implements a minimal API client for a frontend application. It provides functions to perform login, send chat messages, upload documents, and submit feedback, utilizing fetch for HTTP requests and managing JWT tokens in memory and localStorage.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request using fetch, handling JSON and text responses, and throwing errors for non-OK responses.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login, stores JWT token in memory and localStorage.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message with specified language.

methods.name: uploadDocument
methods.description: Uploads a document file as multipart/form-data.

methods.name: submitFeedback
methods.description: Submits user feedback and optional rating.
